Name: 无日之城
TotalDescribe: <main>白曜圣庭诞生在没有真正太阳的时代。为了让城市继续拥有昼夜、礼拜、净化和灾厄预警，圣庭制造了第二日轮。你翻开被灼痕封住的记录，纸页边缘仍有金白色余温。</main>
TotalDescribe_zh-Hant: <main>白曜聖庭誕生在沒有真正太陽的時代。為了讓城市繼續擁有晝夜、禮拜、淨化和災厄預警，聖庭製造了第二日輪。你翻開被灼痕封住的記錄，紙頁邊緣仍有金白色餘溫。</main>
TotalDescribe_en: <main>The sanctuary built the second sun in a sunless age. A scorched record still keeps its pale gold warmth.</main>
TotalDescribe_ja: <main>The sanctuary built the second sun in a sunless age. A scorched record still keeps its pale gold warmth.</main>
1Describe: <main>校准第一缕晨辉</main><add>获得100金币和晨辉碎片</add><subtip>那是从腐坏天幕中提炼出的第一缕无污染光。</subtip>
1Describe_zh-Hant: <main>校準第一縷晨輝</main><add>獲得100金幣和晨輝碎片</add><subtip>那是從腐壞天幕中提煉出的第一縷無污染光。</subtip>
1Describe_en: <main>Calibrate dawnlight</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Morning Shard</add><subtip>The first clean light from the stained sky.</subtip>
1Describe_ja: <main>Calibrate dawnlight</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Morning Shard</add><subtip>The first clean light from the stained sky.</subtip>
2Describe: <main>向圣庭祈祷</main><add>获得100金币和天使祝福</add><subtip>旧日礼拜的回声仍愿庇护旅人。</subtip>
2Describe_zh-Hant: <main>向聖庭祈禱</main><add>獲得100金幣和天使祝福</add><subtip>舊日禮拜的回聲仍願庇護旅人。</subtip>
2Describe_en: <main>Pray to the sanctuary</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Angel blessing</add><subtip>An old prayer shelters travelers.</subtip>
2Describe_ja: <main>Pray to the sanctuary</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Angel blessing</add><subtip>An old prayer shelters travelers.</subtip>

Name: 秩序化光辉
TotalDescribe: <main>乌娜曾经管理这套奇迹。镜阵转向正确的街区，钟声落在正确的时辰，礼拜、净化和守夜人的警戒彼此咬合。她相信光可以被整理、测量和分配。</main>
TotalDescribe_zh-Hant: <main>烏娜曾經管理這套奇蹟。鏡陣轉向正確的街區，鐘聲落在正確的時辰，禮拜、淨化和守夜人的警戒彼此咬合。她相信光可以被整理、測量和分配。</main>
TotalDescribe_en: <main>Una once managed mirrors and bells. She believed light could be measured and assigned.</main>
TotalDescribe_ja: <main>Una once managed mirrors and bells. She believed light could be measured and assigned.</main>
1Describe: <main>转动环日镜</main><add>获得100金币和环日镜</add><subtip>镜阵核心仍记得城市的晨钟与祷告周期。</subtip>
1Describe_zh-Hant: <main>轉動環日鏡</main><add>獲得100金幣和環日鏡</add><subtip>鏡陣核心仍記得城市的晨鐘與祈禱週期。</subtip>
1Describe_en: <main>Turn the orbit mirror</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Sun Orbit Mirror</add><subtip>The mirror remembers bells and prayers.</subtip>
1Describe_ja: <main>Turn the orbit mirror</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Sun Orbit Mirror</add><subtip>The mirror remembers bells and prayers.</subtip>
2Describe: <main>记录礼拜时辰</main><add>获得100金币和天使祝福</add><subtip>一段尚未熄灭的礼拜时辰落入你手中。</subtip>
2Describe_zh-Hant: <main>記錄禮拜時辰</main><add>獲得100金幣和天使祝福</add><subtip>一段尚未熄滅的禮拜時辰落入你手中。</subtip>
2Describe_en: <main>Record the prayer hour</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Angel blessing</add><subtip>A prayer hour comes to you.</subtip>
2Describe_ja: <main>Record the prayer hour</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Angel blessing</add><subtip>A prayer hour comes to you.</subtip>

Name: 光中的污染
TotalDescribe: <main>深渊污染了天幕。乌娜终于明白，腐坏并不畏惧光。它寄生在光里，顺着每一次照耀进入血肉、墙体和祈祷。</main>
TotalDescribe_zh-Hant: <main>深淵污染了天幕。烏娜終於明白，腐壞並不畏懼光。它寄生在光裡，順著每一次照耀進入血肉、牆體和祈禱。</main>
TotalDescribe_en: <main>The Abyss stained the sky. Corruption nested inside light and entered flesh and prayer.</main>
TotalDescribe_ja: <main>The Abyss stained the sky. Corruption nested inside light and entered flesh and prayer.</main>
1Describe: <main>检验日心棱镜</main><add>获得100金币和日心棱镜</add><subtip>纯净的光会折出晨色，带污的光只会沉成黑金。</subtip>
1Describe_zh-Hant: <main>檢驗日心棱鏡</main><add>獲得100金幣和日心棱鏡</add><subtip>純淨的光會折出晨色，帶污的光只會沉成黑金。</subtip>
1Describe_en: <main>Test the solar prism</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Solar Prism</add><subtip>Clean light bends into dawn.</subtip>
1Describe_ja: <main>Test the solar prism</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Solar Prism</add><subtip>Clean light bends into dawn.</subtip>
2Describe: <main>标记腐坏源头</main><add>获得100金币和萨满祝福</add><subtip>污染被指认，敌影因此暴露。</subtip>
2Describe_zh-Hant: <main>標記腐壞源頭</main><add>獲得100金幣和薩滿祝福</add><subtip>污染被指認，敵影因此暴露。</subtip>
2Describe_en: <main>Mark the source</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Shaman blessing</add><subtip>Enemy shadows are exposed.</subtip>
2Describe_ja: <main>Mark the source</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Shaman blessing</add><subtip>Enemy shadows are exposed.</subtip>

Name: 将灾厄引入自身
TotalDescribe: <main>乌娜改变了仪式。光仍会落下，只是先穿过她。灼烧、病痛、祈愿、恐惧和腐坏的残响被她收进身体，再压缩成可以短暂控制的聚炎。</main>
TotalDescribe_zh-Hant: <main>烏娜改變了儀式。光仍會落下，只是先穿過她。灼燒、病痛、祈願、恐懼和腐壞的殘響被她收進身體，再壓縮成可以短暫控制的聚炎。</main>
TotalDescribe_en: <main>Una let light pass through her first. Pain and prayer were compressed into gathered flame.</main>
TotalDescribe_ja: <main>Una let light pass through her first. Pain and prayer were compressed into gathered flame.</main>
1Describe: <main>收拢聚炎护符</main><add>获得100金币和聚炎护符</add><subtip>新增的灼痕和祈愿残响被压入符心。</subtip>
1Describe_zh-Hant: <main>收攏聚炎護符</main><add>獲得100金幣和聚炎護符</add><subtip>新增的灼痕和祈願殘響被壓入符心。</subtip>
1Describe_en: <main>Gather the flame charm</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Gathered Flame Charm</add><subtip>Scars and prayers sink into the charm.</subtip>
1Describe_ja: <main>Gather the flame charm</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Gathered Flame Charm</add><subtip>Scars and prayers sink into the charm.</subtip>
2Describe: <main>披上烬衣衬布</main><add>获得100金币和烬衣衬布</add><subtip>贴身的灰金灼纹记录了承受、转化和代价。</subtip>
2Describe_zh-Hant: <main>披上燼衣襯布</main><add>獲得100金幣和燼衣襯布</add><subtip>貼身的灰金灼紋記錄了承受、轉化和代價。</subtip>
2Describe_en: <main>Wear the ember lining</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Ember Cloak Lining</add><subtip>Ash gold marks record the cost.</subtip>
2Describe_ja: <main>Wear the ember lining</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Ember Cloak Lining</add><subtip>Ash gold marks record the cost.</subtip>

Name: 破碎冠冕
TotalDescribe: <main>乌娜试图把全城灾厄、祈祷和灼痛收入曜日冕冠。仪式失败了。冠冕破碎，授冕圣座倾毁，圣庭记录中属于乌娜的名字被烧穿。</main>
TotalDescribe_zh-Hant: <main>烏娜試圖把全城災厄、祈禱和灼痛收入曜日冕冠。儀式失敗了。冠冕破碎，授冕聖座傾毀，聖庭記錄中屬於烏娜的名字被燒穿。</main>
TotalDescribe_en: <main>Una gathered calamity into the solar crown. The rite failed and her name burned through the records.</main>
TotalDescribe_ja: <main>Una gathered calamity into the solar crown. The rite failed and her name burned through the records.</main>
1Describe: <main>触碰破碎冠冕</main><add>获得100金币和炽冕崩落</add><subtip>爆裂的冠冕仍保留着最后一次净化的余威。</subtip>
1Describe_zh-Hant: <main>觸碰破碎冠冕</main><add>獲得100金幣和熾冕崩落</add><subtip>爆裂的冠冕仍保留著最後一次淨化的餘威。</subtip>
1Describe_en: <main>Touch the shattered crown</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Blazing Crown Collapse</add><subtip>The broken crown still burns.</subtip>
1Describe_ja: <main>Touch the shattered crown</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Blazing Crown Collapse</add><subtip>The broken crown still burns.</subtip>
2Describe: <main>扶起授冕圣座</main><add>获得100金币和授冕圣座</add><subtip>倾毁的圣座仍与第二日轮相连。</subtip>
2Describe_zh-Hant: <main>扶起授冕聖座</main><add>獲得100金幣和授冕聖座</add><subtip>傾毀的聖座仍與第二日輪相連。</subtip>
2Describe_en: <main>Raise the coronation throne</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Coronation Throne</add><subtip>The fallen throne still links to the sun.</subtip>
2Describe_ja: <main>Raise the coronation throne</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Coronation Throne</add><subtip>The fallen throne still links to the sun.</subtip>

Name: 曜日魔女
TotalDescribe: <main>光辉的圣女死去，曜日魔女醒来。她不再祈求光照向所有人。腐坏之物会被她杀死，被烧尽的人会由她记住。</main>
TotalDescribe_zh-Hant: <main>光輝的聖女死去，曜日魔女醒來。她不再祈求光照向所有人。腐壞之物會被她殺死，被燒盡的人會由她記住。</main>
TotalDescribe_en: <main>The saint died and the Solar Witch awoke. Corruption would be killed and the burned would be remembered.</main>
TotalDescribe_ja: <main>The saint died and the Solar Witch awoke. Corruption would be killed and the burned would be remembered.</main>
1Describe: <main>裁定腐坏</main><add>获得100金币和炽冠圣心</add><subtip>破碎冠冕与心脏熔合，成为曜日魔女裁定终焉的核心。</subtip>
1Describe_zh-Hant: <main>裁定腐壞</main><add>獲得100金幣和熾冠聖心</add><subtip>破碎冠冕與心臟熔合，成為曜日魔女裁定終焉的核心。</subtip>
1Describe_en: <main>Judge the corruption</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Blazing Crown Heart</add><subtip>The crown fuses with the heart.</subtip>
1Describe_ja: <main>Judge the corruption</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Blazing Crown Heart</add><subtip>The crown fuses with the heart.</subtip>
2Describe: <main>保存名字与星火</main><add>获得100金币和星火</add><subtip>被烧尽的人仍以星火的形式留下姓名。</subtip>
2Describe_zh-Hant: <main>保存名字與星火</main><add>獲得100金幣和星火</add><subtip>被燒盡的人仍以星火的形式留下姓名。</subtip>
2Describe_en: <main>Preserve names and sparks</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Spark</add><subtip>The burned leave names as sparks.</subtip>
2Describe_ja: <main>Preserve names and sparks</main><add>Gain 100 gold and Spark</add><subtip>The burned leave names as sparks.</subtip>

TotalDescribe_en: <main>The solar record on this floor has already been opened. Warmth remains in the page, but no new chapter appears.</main>
TotalDescribe_ja: <main>The solar record on this floor has already been opened. Warmth remains in the page, but no new chapter appears.</main>

Name: 日耀回忆·开端
TotalDescribe: <main>日轮残光停在乌娜身后，像一枚没有落下的审判。回忆并不急着把你推向战斗。它先打开三只匣子：本源、祝福与卡组。整理好以后，首领会一个接一个醒来。</main>
TotalDescribe_zh-Hant: <main>日輪殘光停在烏娜身後，像一枚沒有落下的審判。回憶並不急著把你推向戰鬥。它先打開三只匣子：本源、祝福與卡組。整理好以後，首領會一個接一個醒來。</main>
TotalDescribe_en: <main>The remaining sun stands behind Una. The memory opens three boxes first: origins, blessings, and deck. When preparation ends, bosses will wake one by one.</main>
TotalDescribe_ja: <main>The remaining sun stands behind Una. The memory opens three boxes first: origins, blessings, and deck. When preparation ends, bosses will wake one by one.</main>
